caption: Fig. 2(a) — Mesh-aligned two-level octree for the MALMO algorithm (2-D schematic). Blue cells: coarse level ell (delta=1), present only outside the refined region. Orange cells: fine level ell+1 (delta=0.5), covering the refined region. Coarse cells are absent where the mesh is refined (annotated). Blue/orange dotted curves: per-level Z-order traversals. Cell labels: composite key (morton_code, level). Red element: multi-cell registered near the boundary, assigned to cells at both levels.
description: Print-ready figure for Section 4.3. White background.
